rules.agent: Discretionary agentic book. Cursor agent decides via stocks.decide from shared candidates. Baseline — not auto-traded by the engine.
rules.bigbeat_gap: Long when EPS surprise >15%, first open gaps up >5% vs prior close, and SPY is above its 50-day SMA. 10% equity, max 8, hold 3 days, no stop.
rules.guidance_beat: Long when 8-K/press release shows raised guidance AND EPS beat >8%, with the release out before the entry open. 10% equity, max 8, hold 5, no stop.
rules.beat5_raise: Long on EPS beat >5% plus raised outlook. No SPY regime filter. 10% equity, max 8, hold 5 days, no stop.
rules.miss_short: Short when EPS misses by more than 10% AND the stock gaps down >5% at the first open. 5% equity, max 4, hold 2 days, hard 8% stop.
